our_interpretation: In context, it refers to object permanence and continuity across occlusion or camera movement.
The plain reading is that later Sora versions will not reliably preserve objects and their identities when temporarily hidden.
Even with mountains of data is a concession about extensive training, not a specified future antecedent. No dataset size, increase or training intervention is given.
Reliability does not require every generated frame to be perfect.
criteria.support_condition: Decisive evidence would need to establish an enduring inability to maintain object permanence despite extensive training. Repeated failures in available models are provisional evidence only.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A later Sora version reliably preserves object existence and identity across varied, independently tested occlusions and camera movements.
